Alex’s typical Friday unfolded with steady but unspectacular engagement. Yet the absence of major negative events kept stress moderate and psychological safety intact, preventing deeper slumps. The day’s digital load and minor physical discomforts added to his cognitive load, while weekend proximity offered a faint but welcome uplift. Overall, Alex’s day was a nuanced blend of resilience and vulnerability, reflecting his fluctuating but contained emotional texture.
